body:
Source: GitHub issue #808 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ e2bc60ab: `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs` (around line 362) computes `const isMain = process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === \`file://${process.argv[1]}\`;` — a hand-built URL string. `import.meta.url` is a proper `file://` URL produced by the URL spec (percent-encoded, forward-slashed); a hand-concatenated `file://${path}` is NOT the same string whenever the path contains a space, a non-ASCII character, or (on Windows) a drive letter / backslash separators. The comparison then silently fails, `isMain` is `false`, and `main()` never runs — the hook exits 0 with empty stdout, indistinguishable from "nothing to report". This backs SEVEN lifecycle hook registrations (see `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/hooks.json`), so all seven silently no-op under any affected path.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. The SAME plugin's sibling file `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs` (line 326) already has the CORRECT pattern: `const isMain = Boolean(process.argv[1]) && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href;` using Node's own `pathToFileURL` (from `node:url`) — this correctly handles spaces, unicode, and Windows paths because it goes through the same URL-construction code path `import.meta.url` itself uses. `scripts/preflight.mjs:106` in the root repo uses the identical correct pattern. Mirror it exactly.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs`, import `pathToFileURL` from `node:url` and replace the `isMain` line with `const isMain = Boolean(process.argv[1]) && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href;` — byte-for-byte the same expression already proven correct in `adlc-build-gate.mjs`.
2. Do not touch `adlc-build-gate.mjs` (it is already correct) or `adlc-rails-guard.mjs` (out of scope — check it separately if curious, but do not fix it here unless it has the SAME exact broken pattern; if it does, note that as a finding in the PR body but do not fix it — one ticket, one file's bug).
3. No behavioural change to what `main()` does once it runs — this is purely fixing WHETHER it runs.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A regression test that imports the module and asserts running `node adlc-lifecycle.mjs <mode>` from a directory path CONTAINING A SPACE (e.g. a tmpdir named `a b/`) produces real stdout output (not silent exit 0 with nothing printed) for at least one mode. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/isMain-space-path.test.mjs`
- AC2 The `isMain` expression matches `adlc-build-gate.mjs`'s pattern exactly (grep-comparable). verify: `node -e "const a=require('fs').readFileSync('plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs','utf8'); const b=require('fs').readFileSync('plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs','utf8'); if(!a.includes('pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href')) process.exit(1)"`
- AC3 Existing suite green (39/39 baseline or current count — confirm actual). verify: `npm test -w plugins/adlc-copilot` or `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC4 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: adlc-rails-guard.mjs, adlc-build-gate.mjs (already correct), and any other plugin's isMain pattern.

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/isMain-space-path.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: the package suite, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs, its test, and this ticket's shard. PR title `fix(adlc-copilot): ...`, body must contain `Closes #808`.
title: plugin(adlc-copilot): fix adlc-lifecycle.mjs's isMain check so all 7 lifecycle hooks actually run
